document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You locate a couple of books, which look interesting. If you can 
make a successful Language (Arabic) roll, or have an English/
Arabic dictionary and make a Know (EDU) roll, you can examine 
the following: 
• For a version of The Book Of The Dead, go to 218.
• For Alhazred and the Curse Of Egypt, go to 267.
• If you failed to read the books you may return to try again on 
another day.
If you spend two further hours and successfully make the 
appropriate Language roll, you find and understand more tomes: 
• For the Mysterium (in Latin), go to 262.
• For The Lost Pyramid (in English), go to 284. 
• If you fail a roll, you may try again on another day.
When finished here, you can go to the university of Al-Azhar 
entry at 149, or return to the university’s library at 215. 
(215, 218, 262, 267, 284)
